acceptedBehavior: Directional body poses, phase order and long adult body proportions match the original drawings visually. Small intentional head movement tied to attacks is acceptable; unrelated complete side-profile substitutions in up rows were reported and corrected.
W07 walking front-view quiver arrow tips are hidden by the body in both old and new source; the quiver remains visible in side/back views.
RGB colors visible in fully transparent/very-low-alpha pixels are not evidence of opaque backgrounds. Actual alpha measured with threshold16/255 is recorded per source.

Ornate W08 bow keeps silver branching limbs/green gems; L02 keeps its blue/crescent ornamental silhouette; W02 red groove and L01 blue ornate blade remain distinct; W11 staff keeps white orb/long shaft.
nativeQAStillRequired: Real Cocos material alpha discard on busy terrain and interior backgrounds.
Final per-frame crop registration and world-height consistency from merged manifest.
Female three NPCs in S01-T1, S05 and U1-04, with native four-direction texture/face/feet review.

nonMaterialEdgeObservations.assessment: Very small sole fringe at an already edge-adjacent baseline sprite; not a material whole-body/prop clipping regression. Check native crop at normal play scale.
Two antialiased bow-tip edge pixels, no opaque core on boundary. Check native thin-limb continuity; no full-sheet regeneration requested.
